text: The boiler is making a loud banging noise when it comes on. It's still working and we've got hot water. Didn't do this before. 8 Carlton Street.
notes: Client message 6. Banging but working boiler is Urgent (D4). The word 'gas' does not appear, so the gas rule must not fire; an AI that reads 'boiler' as gas and raises to Emergency is an over-escalation (tolerable).
